4.name: 4-Team Playoff
4.description: The top 4 teams in the Power Digits rankings, seeded 1-4. No automatic bids.
4.label: seed

8.name: 8-Team Playoff
8.description: Automatic bids go to the top-ranked Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 teams and the top-ranked Group of 5 team; the rest are at-large. All teams are seeded by Power Digits rank.
8.label: seed

12.name: 12-Team Playoff
12.description: Automatic bids go to the top-ranked Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 teams and the top-ranked Group of 5 team; the rest are at-large. All teams are seeded by Power Digits rank, and seeds 1-4 get first-round byes.
12.label: seed

24.name: 24-Team Playoff
24.description: Automatic bids go to the top-ranked Big Ten, SEC, ACC and Big 12 teams and the top-ranked Group of 5 team; the rest are at-large. All teams are seeded by Power Digits rank, and seeds 1-8 get first-round byes.
24.label: seed

24c.name: 24-Team Champions Playoff
24c.description: All 10 conference champions (each conference's top-ranked team) get automatic bids; the rest are at-large. All teams are seeded by Power Digits rank, and seeds 1-8 get first-round byes.
24c.label: seed

32.name: 32-Team Playoff
32.description: All 10 conference champions (each conference's top-ranked team) get automatic bids; the rest are at-large. All teams are seeded by Power Digits rank, with no byes.
32.label: seed

20conf.name: 20-Team Conference Playoff
20conf.description: All 10 conference champions get in. The top 4 Big Ten and SEC teams play their own regions; the ACC and Big 12 regions add three Group of 5 champions in a play-in round. Region winners meet in the semifinals. Numbers shown are Power Digits ranks.
20conf.label: rank

24conf.name: 24-Team Conference Playoff
24conf.description: All 10 conference champions get in. The top 6 Big Ten and SEC teams play their own regions; the ACC and Big 12 regions add three Group of 5 champions in a play-in round. Region winners meet in the semifinals. Numbers shown are Power Digits ranks.
24conf.label: rank
